*Our Unforgettable Uttarakhand Adventure:*
Spirituality, Thrills, and Serenity

We just wrapped up an incredible trip across Uttarakhand, organized by Parikrama Holidays (Sameer Chheda). Traveling as a close-knit group of three, the agency kept in constant touch to ensure everything ran perfectly. Our driver was exceptional, navigating the mountain roads with ease and expert local knowledge.
Here are the highlights from our journey:

🥞 *Mussoorie:* Sweet Treats & Scenic Streets
The Vibe: Mall Road offered fantastic shopping and delicious street food.
The Food: Landour Bakehouse is an absolute must-visit. Do not miss their chocolate croissants and chocolate cake.
The Stay: Hotel Vishnu Palace delivered great service and excellent food.

*Rishikesh & Haridwar:* Divine Views & White Water
The Vibe: Witnessing the Ganga Aarti in both Haridwar and Rishikesh was a deeply spiritual experience.
The Thrill: Whitewater river rafting provided an incredible adrenaline rush.
The Stay: Hotel Reiveries Luxury was superb. Watching the Ganga River flow right from our room window was pure serenity.
Tip: The staff is wonderful, and their mint mojito is spectacular.

🐅 *Jim Corbett:* Wild Encounters & High Flies
The Vibe: Pure nature. The Jim Corbett Waterfall is beautiful and well worth the visit.
The Thrill: The jungle safari was a massive success, topped off by a breathtaking hot air balloon ride.
The Stay: River Edge Resort featured great rooms with direct river views. We regularly spotted wild Sambhar and spotted deer right from our room.

🌸 *Mukteshwar:* The Perfect Himalayan Escape
The Stay: Ojaswi Himalayan Resort is an absolute paradise. Their stunning flower showcase makes it a must-visit destination where you can easily unwind for two full days.
The Food: The staff and service were flawless. Make sure to try their incredible Kashmiri Kofta.

🛶 *Nainital & Bhimtal:* Lakes & Landscapes
Nainital: We stopped by for a scenic day tour and visited the high-altitude zoo, where we got to see a tiger and a leopard.
Bhimtal: We stayed in a beautiful hotel facing the lake, enjoying great food and service. The highlight here was thrilling paragliding over the valley.
